diagnosis.cause: `bun` is not installed; the docs assume it is.

actions.command: command -v bun >/dev/null || { if command -v npm >/dev/null; then npm install -g bun; else apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq unzip curl >/dev/null && curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && ln -sf "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun; fi; }
